control: Развести practice, word attestation, philosophical systematization and legal canonization
risk: Поздние texts retro-project a timeless precolonial doctrine
Human quality, virtue, humanism, worldview, relation and jurisprudential value смешиваются

control: Model proverb as text-expression, then map interpretations
risk: One aphorism replaces argument and variation

needed_sources: African philosophy histories; comparative linguistic work
risk: Southern African terms become doctrine for all Africa

control: Preserve originals, gloss, translator and competing translations
risk: English community/humanity/harmony erase morphology and usage

control: Require text/speaker/recorder provenance; distinguish reconstruction from explicit philosophy
risk: Collective worldview attributed without identifiable arguments or agents

control: Add power, class, gender, generation and dissent nodes
risk: Community treated as harmonious, egalitarian, nonviolent

control: Map hybrid theories and constitutional practice
risk: African duties opposed to Western rights as homogeneous wholes

control: Trace act, negotiations, theological leadership, comparative models and later narrative
risk: Institution’s full architecture reduced to one cultural source
Distinct concepts become a moral sequence imposed on victims

control: Store accountability, prosecution, amnesty, reparation and structural benefit separately
needed_sources: AZAPO; TRC report; critical transitional-justice literature
risk: Disclosure is treated as sufficient justice
A quotation is treated as binding doctrine

control: Model doctrine-specific tests and legal certainty
risk: Ubuntu becomes open-ended fairness overriding law

control: Track local evidence, change and equality review
risk: Official codified custom is treated as living community norm
Transcript seems transparent but is selected and translated
Term becomes nation-brand, governance slogan or depoliticized reconciliation

control: Record digitized fraction, paywall, language and repository metadata
risk: SAFLII and English journals dominate what seems canonical

contribution: Ранний письменный порог и изменение значений; доказывает употребления, но не единую доктрину.
reliability: Высокая для аттестаций, средняя для реконструкции local voice; нужен item-level provenance.
source_label: Ранний письменный ubuntu / botho / hunhu corpus, 1846–1950
source_type: Словари, миссионерская, педагогическая и периодическая печать

contribution: Black Consciousness, dignity, agency, liberation и humanism как важный входящий corpus.
reliability: Высокая; различать исходные тексты, редакторскую сборку и поздние переиздания.
source_access: Biko Foundation / archive gateway; академические издания
source_label: Steve Biko, I Write What I Like

contribution: Один из ранних явных проектов Hunhuism/Ubuntuism как философии, морали и государственного принципа.
reliability: Библиографически высокая, доступность низкая; цитаты проверять по экземпляру.
source_label: S. J. W. T. Samkange & T. M. Samkange, Hunhuism or Ubuntuism

contribution: Порог legal inscription: understanding, reparation and ubuntu противопоставлены vengeance, retaliation and victimisation.
reliability: Очень высокая; цитировать postamble и конкретную редакцию.
source_label: Constitution of the Republic of South Africa Act 200 of 1993, Postamble

contribution: Создаёт TRC и определяет truth, gross violations, victim, amnesty, reparation and reconciliation.
reliability: Очень высокая; отделять текст закона от практики Комиссии и поздней интерпретации.
source_label: Promotion of National Unity and Reconciliation Act 34 of 1995

contribution: Dignity, equality, freedom, healing divisions and social justice — нормативная матрица ubuntu jurisprudence.
reliability: Очень высокая; ubuntu не является отдельной express clause.
source_label: Constitution of the Republic of South Africa, 1996

contribution: Voice, acknowledgement, trauma, translation, confession, responsibility, forgiveness and refusal.
reliability: Высокая для сохранившихся transcripts; corpus неполон, translation provenance неравномерен.
source_label: TRC human-rights-violation hearings, statements and special hearings

contribution: Институциональная narrative architecture: violations, amnesty, victims, reparation, reconciliation, recommendations.
reliability: Очень высокая как официальный self-account; не нейтральный census всех опытов.
source_label: Truth and Reconciliation Commission of South Africa, Final Report

contribution: Влиятельная Christian-ubuntu интерпретация reconciliation и forgiveness; важна также тема reparation.
reliability: Высокая; авторская интерпретация не равна единой позиции TRC или языковой традиции.
source_label: Desmond Tutu, No Future Without Forgiveness
source_type: Публичная теология, memoir and ethical argument, 1999

contribution: Ontology of be-ing/becoming, epistemology, justice, liberation and critique of conquest.
reliability: Очень высокая для системного философского корпуса; edition history требует нормализации.
source_label: Mogobe B. Ramose, African Philosophy through Ubuntu

contribution: Communal formation, freedom, common good and moral development; один из ключевых систематизирующих проектов.
reliability: Высокая; нормативный проект нельзя выдавать за этнографическое описание всех общин.
source_label: Augustine Shutte, Ubuntu: An Ethic for a New South Africa

contribution: Remorse, empathy, evil, encounter and limits of forgiveness в afterlife TRC.
reliability: Высокая; различать интервью-событие, memoir composition и последующую рецепцию.
source_access: Издательские и библиотечные каталоги; печатные/электронные editions
source_label: Pumla Gobodo-Madikizela, A Human Being Died That Night

contribution: Death penalty, dignity, humane punishment, interdependence; основной judicial ubuntu anchor.
reliability: Очень высокая; тезисы распределены между отдельными opinions, не одной unanimous doctrine.
source_label: S v Makwanyane and Another [1995] ZACC 3

contribution: Конституционность amnesty; интеграция truth, reconciliation and reparation в transitional jurisprudence.
reliability: Очень высокая; judgment не доказывает моральную достаточность фактических reparations.
source_label: AZAPO v President of the Republic of South Africa [1996] ZACC 16

contribution: Dignity, equality, compassion and anti-stigma reasoning вне узкого TRC-контекста.
reliability: Очень высокая; ubuntu relation интерпретируется в wider constitutional value network.
source_label: Hoffmann v South African Airways [2000] ZACC 17

contribution: Eviction, housing, mediation, grace and compassion; relation-centered public law.
reliability: Очень высокая; не превращать case-specific proportionality в general anti-property rule.
source_label: Port Elizabeth Municipality v Various Occupiers [2004] ZACC 7

contribution: Gender equality, succession and living customary law; критический предел romantic communitarianism.
reliability: Очень высокая; различать customary-law reform, equality review and ubuntu rhetoric.
source_label: Bhe v Magistrate, Khayelitsha [2004] ZACC 17

contribution: Defamation, apology, amends, dignity and restorative remedies.
reliability: Очень высокая; наиболее сильные ubuntu passages могут находиться в отдельном opinion.
source_label: Dikoko v Mokhatla [2006] ZACC 10

contribution: Primary caregiver, children, relational effects of punishment and restorative justice.
reliability: Очень высокая; кодировать фактический context и legal holding отдельно от ethical exposition.
source_label: S v M [2007] ZACC 18

contribution: Diversion, child-sensitive procedure and restorative-justice vocabulary.
reliability: Очень высокая для нормы; связь с ubuntu должна подтверждаться provisions/cases, не предполагаться.
source_label: Child Justice Act 75 of 2008

contribution: Good faith, fairness, public policy and возможность развития contract law через constitutional values.
reliability: Очень высокая; largely procedural posture limits doctrinal overstatement.
source_label: Everfresh Market Virginia v Shoprite Checkers [2011] ZACC 30

contribution: Pacta sunt servanda, public policy, fairness and ubuntu; дисциплинирует slogan-based non-enforcement.
reliability: Очень высокая; majority/dissent and test structure must be separated.
source_label: Beadica 231 CC v Trustees for the time being of the Oregon Trust [2020] ZACC 13

contribution: Systematic theory of right action through identity and solidarity; analytic bridge to global ethics.
reliability: Очень высокая; one influential theory, not definition of ubuntu simpliciter.
source_label: Thaddeus Metz, “Toward an African Moral Theory”

contribution: Проверяет relational moral theory как foundation and interpretive resource for human rights.
reliability: Очень высокая; normative proposal must be distinguished from positive constitutional doctrine.
source_access: African Human Rights Law Journal full text
source_label: Thaddeus Metz, “Ubuntu as a Moral Theory and Human Rights in South Africa”

contribution: Normative personhood, virtue, dignity, duties and political implications.
reliability: Очень высокая; author-specific reconstruction within wider African personhood debate.
source_label: Motsamai Molefe, An African Philosophy of Personhood, Morality, and Politics

contribution: Ethical humanism, dignity, virtue, historical injustice, basic goods and ecological inequality.
reliability: Высокая и актуальная; handbook intervention, not settled field consensus.
source_label: Motsamai Molefe, “Ubuntu and Social Justice”

contribution: Живое продолжение contract/public-authority debate после Beadica.
reliability: Очень высокая; precise ubuntu relevance should be stored paragraph-by-paragraph.
source_label: Greater Tzaneen Municipality v Bravospan 252 CC [2024] ZACC 20

contribution: Master-row T3-61: dates, status, confidence, seeds, media, anchors and risk.
reliability: Канонична для архитектуры; не заменяет внешнюю фактологическую проверку.
source_label: Каноническая Таблица III ToS v1.0

contribution: Официальный witness postamble и constitutional transition.
reliability: Максимальная для текста; PDF metadata/edition фиксировать.
source_label: South African Department of Justice — Interim Constitution

contribution: Официальный действующий constitutional text и multilingual gateway.
reliability: Максимальная; historical versions держать отдельно.
source_label: South African Department of Justice — Constitution 1996

contribution: Статуты, включая Act 34/1995 и Child Justice Act.
reliability: Максимальная для official copies; amendments проверять по version date.
source_label: South African legislation portal

contribution: Reports, transcripts, legal material, submissions and institutional chronology.
reliability: Очень высокая, но digital completeness and transcript provenance uneven.
source_label: Truth and Reconciliation Commission official archive

contribution: Searchable judgments, paragraph identifiers, neutral citations and linked authorities.
reliability: Очень высокая access layer; compare court-issued PDF where available.
source_label: Southern African Legal Information Institute — SAFLII

contribution: Archival collections, objects, histories and court institutional memory.
reliability: Высокая; curated collection, not complete case-law database.
source_label: Constitutional Court Collections

contribution: Open legal-philosophical articles on ubuntu, rights and jurisprudence.
reliability: Высокая peer-reviewed access; article-level metadata required.
source_label: African Human Rights Law Journal / Centre for Human Rights

contribution: Ubuntu jurisprudence studies, full text and DOI metadata.
reliability: Высокая; HTML/PDF versions may differ in pagination.
source_label: Potchefstroom Electronic Law Journal / SciELO South Africa

contribution: Core philosophical debate, including Gade, Metz, Matolino, Praeg and replies.
reliability: Высокая; coverage/paywall and issue metadata vary.
source_label: South African Journal of Philosophy / AJOL / publisher platform

contribution: Bibliographic discovery, author records, open manuscripts and citation graph.
reliability: High for discovery, not a substitute for edition or publisher record.
source_label: PhilPapers / PhilArchive

contribution: Institutional metadata, accepted manuscripts and hard-to-find monograph records.
reliability: Variable; repository version, rights and completeness must be recorded.
source_access: Aarhus Pure · UJ Content · Google Books
source_label: University repositories and book catalogues

contribution: Письменные употребления с 1846; изменение definitions; датировка proverb-as-definition.
limitations: Corpus ограничен доступными письменными источниками; не история всех lived practices.
source_label: Christian B. N. Gade, “The Historical Development of the Written Discourses on Ubuntu,” South African Journal of Philosophy 30(3), 2011, 303–329.

contribution: Документирует множественность contemporary interpretations.
limitations: Interview sample не представляет всех языков, регионов или поколений.
source_label: Christian B. N. Gade, “What Is Ubuntu? Different Interpretations among South Africans of African Descent,” SAJP 31(3), 2012, 484–503.

contribution: Показывает позднее и ограниченное присутствие phrase “restorative justice” в TRC transcripts; осложняет simple ubuntu genealogy.
limitations: История термина не исчерпывает практические restorative features.
source_label: Christian B. N. Gade, “Restorative Justice and the South African Truth and Reconciliation Process,” SAJP 32(1), 2013, 10–35.

contribution: Связывает historical semantics, interviews, TRC actors and critique of static ethnophilosophy.
limitations: Сильная авторская reconstruction; сопоставлять с TRC records and critics.
source_label: Christian B. N. Gade, A Discourse on African Philosophy: A New Perspective on Ubuntu and Transitional Justice in South Africa, Lexington Books, 2017.

contribution: Humanism, history, identity and political uses of ubuntu in post-apartheid South Africa.
limitations: Шире T3-61; narrative synthesis needs source-level decomposition.
source_label: Michael Onyebuchi Eze, Intellectual History in Contemporary South Africa, Palgrave Macmillan, 2010.

contribution: Доступный обзор языков, philosophical claims, personhood, ethics and debates.
limitations: Обзорный жанр; для спорных dates and claims нужны primary/specialist sources.
source_label: Internet Encyclopedia of Philosophy, “Hunhu/Ubuntu in Traditional Southern African Thought.”

contribution: Ключевая карта relation between ubuntu, dignity, jurisprudence, gender, law and political transition.
limitations: Разноавторская книга; позиции не сливать в единый thesis.
source_label: Drucilla Cornell & Nyoko Muvangua (eds.), Ubuntu and the Law: African Ideals and Postapartheid Jurisprudence, Fordham University Press, 2012.

contribution: Читает ubuntu как open equitable norm and gateway for African values in law.
limitations: Equity analogy продуктивна, но не универсальна для всех doctrinal fields.
source_label: T. W. Bennett, “Ubuntu: An African Equity,” Potchefstroom Electronic Law Journal 14(4), 2011, 30–61.

contribution: Разбирает multifaceted and polycentric judicial uses across legal fields.
limitations: Охватывает корпус до 2013; нуждается в обновлении Beadica/2024 cases.
source_label: Chuma Himonga, Max Taylor & Anne Pope, “Reflections on Judicial Views of Ubuntu,” PELJ 16(5), 2013, 369–427.

contribution: Позднейшая карта constitutional/public/private-law uptake.
limitations: Стремится выявить trend; каждое field claim проверять по case itself.
source_label: Serges Djoyou Kamga, “Cultural Values as a Source of Law: Emerging Trends of Ubuntu Jurisprudence in South Africa,” AHRLJ 18(2), 2018, 625–649.

contribution: Open norms, customary-law encounter and common-law development.
limitations: Специализированный doctrinal lens; не общая теория ubuntu.
source_label: H. M. du Plessis, “Legal Pluralism, uBuntu and the Use of Open Norms in the South African Common Law,” PELJ, 2019.

contribution: Early post-apartheid articulation by a Constitutional Court justice.
limitations: Programmatic and period-specific; later case law modifies the picture.
source_label: Yvonne Mokgoro, “Ubuntu and the Law in South Africa,” Buffalo Human Rights Law Review 4, 1998.

contribution: Политика вопроса “what is ubuntu?”, conceptual personae, plurality and limits of reduction.
limitations: Dense authorial framework; should not displace vernacular and legal corpora.
source_label: Leonhard Praeg, A Report on Ubuntu, University of KwaZulu-Natal Press, 2014.

contribution: Foregrounds archive-making, selection, voice and the politics of preserving ubuntu discourse.
limitations: Curated archive is intentionally selective and interpretive.
source_label: Leonhard Praeg & Siphokazi Magadla (eds.), Ubuntu: Curating the Archive, 2014.

contribution: Challenges contemporary viability and political deployment of ubuntu.
limitations: Strong thesis designed for debate; not empirical demonstration of disappearance.
source_label: Bernard Matolino & Wenceslaus Kwindingwi, “The End of Ubuntu,” SAJP 32(2), 2013, 197–205.

contribution: Defends reconstructive normative philosophy against “end of ubuntu” conclusion.
limitations: Reply remains one position in continuing debate.
source_label: Thaddeus Metz, “Just the Beginning for Ubuntu: Reply to Matolino and Kwindingwi,” SAJP, 2014.

contribution: Exposes definition inflation, sloganization and competing codifications, including Shutte.
limitations: Critical framing; bibliographic version and journal pagination must be normalized.
source_label: N. Mboti, “May the Real Ubuntu Please Stand Up?”, Journal of Media Ethics / UJ open manuscript, 2015.

contribution: Strong communitarian thesis and achieved/normative personhood.
limitations: Not specifically southern African; frequently overgeneralized as “the African view.”
source_label: Ifeanyi A. Menkiti, “Person and Community in African Traditional Thought,” in R. A. Wright (ed.), African Philosophy: An Introduction, 1984, 171–181.

contribution: Moderate communitarianism, rights, personhood, tradition and modern institutions.
limitations: Primarily Akan-oriented and pan-African argument; use as comparative incoming, not ubuntu definition.
source_label: Kwame Gyekye, Tradition and Modernity: Philosophical Reflections on the African Experience, Oxford University Press, 1997.

contribution: Complicates self/community, knowledge, agency, democracy and social transformation.
limitations: Continental scale; T3-61 use must be concept-specific.
source_label: D. A. Masolo, Self and Community in a Changing World, Indiana University Press, 2010.

contribution: Critical account of human-rights talk, legal pluralism, victims and state legitimacy.
limitations: Not an internal philosophical defence of ubuntu; invaluable external control.
source_label: Richard A. Wilson, The Politics of Truth and Reconciliation in South Africa: Legitimizing the Post-Apartheid State, Cambridge University Press, 2001.

contribution: Distinguishes victims/perpetrators, beneficiaries and structural apartheid; tests reconciliation narrative.
limitations: Deliberately polemical and macro-structural; compare with report and legal record.
source_label: Mahmood Mamdani, “Amnesty or Impunity? A Preliminary Critique of the Report of the Truth and Reconciliation Commission of South Africa,” Diacritics 32(3/4), 2002.

contribution: Institutional translation of apology, diversion, accountability and relational repair.
limitations: Field-specific; cannot establish general TRC genealogy.
source_label: Julia Sloth-Nielsen & Jacqui Gallinetti, “Just Say Sorry? Ubuntu, Africanisation and the Child Justice System in the Child Justice Act 75 of 2008,” 2011.

contribution: Argues against imposed forgiveness and for accountability, restitution and relational integrity.
limitations: Very recent intervention; field reception is still developing.
source_label: Keolebogile Mbebe, “Ubuntu Does Not Require Forgiveness: A Critique of the TRC’s Pressure on Apartheid Victims to Forgive Their Perpetrators,” Phronimon 26, 2025.

contribution: Connects personhood/virtue to basic goods, historical injustice and ecological/material conditions.
limitations: One constructive programme, not consensus; crucial current handoff source.
source_label: Motsamai Molefe, “Ubuntu and Social Justice,” in The Oxford Handbook of Social and Political Philosophy in Africa, 2025.
